sentences.text: ¿De qué tamaño es la habitación?
sentences.translation: How big is the room?

sentences.text: Las dos maletas tienen el mismo tamaño.
sentences.translation: The two suitcases are the same size.

sentences.text: Venden cajas de todos los tamaños.
sentences.translation: They sell boxes in all sizes.

notes: A woman is una invitada.

sentences.text: Los invitados llegan a las ocho.
sentences.translation: The guests arrive at eight.

sentences.text: Eres mi invitado, así que pago yo.
sentences.translation: You're my guest, so I'm paying.

sentences.text: Esta semana tenemos una invitada en casa.
sentences.translation: This week we have a guest staying with us.

notes: la declaración de la renta = the yearly tax return.

sentences.text: Tengo que hacer una declaración a la policía.
sentences.translation: I have to make a statement to the police.

sentences.text: El ministro hizo unas declaraciones esta mañana.
sentences.translation: The minister made a statement this morning.

sentences.text: Nadie cree su declaración.
sentences.translation: Nobody believes his statement.

sentences.text: Sin gafas no veo claramente las letras.
sentences.translation: Without glasses I can't see the letters clearly.

sentences.text: Lo dijo claramente: no quiere venir.
sentences.translation: She said it clearly: she doesn't want to come.

sentences.text: Claramente, algo no va bien.
sentences.translation: Clearly, something is wrong.

sentences.text: Esta reunión es una pérdida de tiempo.
sentences.translation: This meeting is a waste of time.

sentences.text: La pérdida de su padre fue muy dura.
sentences.translation: The loss of her father was very hard.

sentences.text: La tienda tuvo pérdidas el año pasado.
sentences.translation: The shop had losses last year.

sentences.text: Cuidado, aquí el agua es profunda.
sentences.translation: Careful, the water is deep here.

sentences.text: Cayó en un sueño profundo.
sentences.translation: He fell into a deep sleep.

sentences.text: En esta zona, los ríos no son muy profundos.
sentences.translation: In this area, the rivers aren't very deep.

notes: agua con gas = sparkling water; agua sin gas = still water.

sentences.text: Huele a gas en la cocina.
sentences.translation: It smells of gas in the kitchen.

sentences.text: En casa siempre bebemos agua con gas.
sentences.translation: At home we always drink sparkling water.

sentences.text: Este mes la factura del gas ha subido.
sentences.translation: The gas bill has gone up this month.

sentences.text: Te llevo al aeropuerto.
sentences.translation: I'll take you to the airport.

sentences.text: El aeropuerto está lejos del centro.
sentences.translation: The airport is far from the center.

sentences.text: En agosto, los aeropuertos están llenos.
sentences.translation: In August, the airports are packed.

notes: In Spain, el instituto is the school for ages 12 to 18.

sentences.text: Mi hija va al instituto.
sentences.translation: My daughter goes to high school.

sentences.text: Mi mejor amigo y yo íbamos juntos al instituto.
sentences.translation: My best friend and I went to high school together.

sentences.text: Trabaja en un instituto de investigación.
sentences.translation: She works at a research institute.

sentences.text: Mis hijos van a institutos distintos.
sentences.translation: My kids go to different high schools.

sentences.text: Oímos un disparo en la calle.
sentences.translation: We heard a shot in the street.

sentences.text: Anoche se oyeron disparos cerca del puerto.
sentences.translation: Shots were heard near the port last night.

sentences.text: El disparo vino de esa casa.
sentences.translation: The shot came from that house.

notes: Adds a z before c in some forms: pertenezco = I belong.

sentences.text: Este libro pertenece a la biblioteca.
sentences.translation: This book belongs to the library.

sentences.text: Siento que no pertenezco a este lugar.
sentences.translation: I feel like I don't belong here.

sentences.text: La casa perteneció a mi abuela.
sentences.translation: The house belonged to my grandmother.

sentences.text: Encontraron un cadáver en el río.
sentences.translation: They found a dead body in the river.

sentences.text: Los estudiantes de medicina trabajan con cadáveres.
sentences.translation: Medical students work with dead bodies.

sentences.text: ¿Venderla? ¡Por encima de mi cadáver!
sentences.translation: Sell it? Over my dead body!

notes: hacer gracia = to find something funny: me hace gracia = I find it funny. gracias = thank you.

sentences.text: Ese chiste no me hace gracia.
sentences.translation: I don't find that joke funny.

sentences.text: Tu hermano tiene mucha gracia.
sentences.translation: Your brother is really funny.

sentences.text: Baila con mucha gracia.
sentences.translation: She dances with great grace.

sentences.text: Su marido tenía una amante.
sentences.translation: Her husband had a lover.

sentences.text: Mi padre es un gran amante de la música.
sentences.translation: My father is a great music lover.

sentences.text: Fueron amantes durante muchos años.
sentences.translation: They were lovers for many years.

gloss: season (busy or quiet time of year; of a show or sport)
notes: For spring, summer and so on, say estación.

sentences.text: En temporada alta, los hoteles son caros.
sentences.translation: In high season, hotels are expensive.

sentences.text: Ya ha salido la nueva temporada de la serie.
sentences.translation: The new season of the show is out.

sentences.text: Llevo dos temporadas en este equipo.
sentences.translation: I've been on this team for two seasons.

notes: Also a person or thing from France: un francés, una francesa.

sentences.text: En Bélgica mucha gente habla francés.
sentences.translation: In Belgium many people speak French.

sentences.text: Mi madre es profesora de francés.
sentences.translation: My mother is a French teacher.

sentences.text: Esta canción está en francés.
sentences.translation: This song is in French.

notes: The roof of a house is usually el tejado.

sentences.text: Me gustan las casas con techos altos.
sentences.translation: I like houses with high ceilings.

sentences.text: Vivimos bajo el mismo techo.
sentences.translation: We live under the same roof.

sentences.text: El gato está en el techo del coche.
sentences.translation: The cat is on the roof of the car.

sentences.text: Ponte protección solar antes de salir.
sentences.translation: Put on sunscreen before you go out.

sentences.text: Este abrigo da buena protección contra el frío.
sentences.translation: This coat gives good protection against the cold.

sentences.text: Lleva casco como protección.
sentences.translation: He wears a helmet for protection.

sentences.text: No busco venganza.
sentences.translation: I'm not looking for revenge.

sentences.text: Lo hizo por venganza.
sentences.translation: He did it out of revenge.

sentences.text: La venganza no te hará feliz.
sentences.translation: Revenge won't make you happy.

notes: Most often it means to argue, not to discuss calmly.

sentences.text: Mis padres discuten mucho.
sentences.translation: My parents argue a lot.

sentences.text: Ayer discutí con mi hermana por una tontería.
sentences.translation: Yesterday I argued with my sister over something silly.

sentences.text: Tenemos que discutir el plan.
sentences.translation: We need to discuss the plan.

sentences.text: ¿Por qué siempre discutimos por dinero?
sentences.translation: Why do we always argue about money?

notes: A little more formal than entender; both are common.

sentences.text: Mi madre no comprende por qué me voy.
sentences.translation: My mother doesn't understand why I'm leaving.

sentences.text: ¿Comprendes lo que te digo?
sentences.translation: Do you understand what I'm telling you?

sentences.text: Al final comprendió su error.
sentences.translation: In the end he understood his mistake.

sentences.text: Llevas la camisa al revés.
sentences.translation: Your shirt is inside out.

sentences.text: Me he comprado una camisa blanca para la entrevista.
sentences.translation: I've bought a white shirt for the interview.

sentences.text: Estas camisas ya no me quedan bien.
sentences.translation: These shirts don't fit me anymore.

gloss: upper, top; better (superior a = better than)
notes: The same form for masculine and feminine.

sentences.text: La parte superior de la caja está rota.
sentences.translation: The top of the box is broken.

sentences.text: Los pisos superiores tienen mejores vistas.
sentences.translation: The upper floors have better views.

sentences.text: Este vino es muy superior al otro.
sentences.translation: This wine is much better than the other one.

sentences.text: Detuvieron al criminal en el aeropuerto.
sentences.translation: They arrested the criminal at the airport.

sentences.text: ¡Que no soy un criminal!
sentences.translation: I'm telling you, I'm not a criminal!

sentences.text: La cárcel está llena de criminales.
sentences.translation: The prison is full of criminals.

notes: A big boat or ship is un barco.

sentences.text: Fuimos a la isla en un bote.
sentences.translation: We went to the island in a small boat.

sentences.text: ¿Me abres este bote? No puedo.
sentences.translation: Can you open this jar for me? I can't.

sentences.text: En el puerto hay muchos botes.
sentences.translation: There are lots of boats in the harbor.

gloss: to pick up, collect; to tidy up
notes: g becomes j before o and a: recojo = I pick up.

sentences.text: ¿Me recoges en la estación?
sentences.translation: Will you pick me up at the station?

sentences.text: Recojo a los niños a las cinco.
sentences.translation: I pick the kids up at five.

sentences.text: Recoge tu habitación, por favor.
sentences.translation: Tidy your room, please.

sentences.text: Ya hemos recogido la mesa.
sentences.translation: We've already cleared the table.

sentences.text: Te enseño un truco de cartas.
sentences.translation: I'll show you a card trick.

sentences.text: Es demasiado barato, seguro que hay truco.
sentences.translation: It's too cheap, there must be a catch.

sentences.text: Mi abuela tiene trucos para todo.
sentences.translation: My grandmother has tricks for everything.

sentences.text: ¡Qué regalo tan original!
sentences.translation: What an original present!

sentences.text: Tiene un estilo muy original.
sentences.translation: She has a very original style.

sentences.text: Necesito las facturas originales, no copias.
sentences.translation: I need the original invoices, not copies.

notes: Also the color pink: un vestido rosa = a pink dress.

sentences.text: Le regaló una rosa roja.
sentences.translation: He gave her a red rose.

sentences.text: En mayo el jardín se llena de rosas.
sentences.translation: In May the garden fills with roses.

sentences.text: Compré una docena de rosas para mi madre.
sentences.translation: I bought a dozen roses for my mother.

notes: sobrevivir a algo = to survive something.

sentences.text: Pocas personas sobreviven a esta enfermedad.
sentences.translation: Few people survive this illness.

sentences.text: Nadie sobrevivió al accidente.
sentences.translation: Nobody survived the accident.

sentences.text: Hemos sobrevivido a cosas peores.
sentences.translation: We've survived worse.

notes: A more formal word than cara.

sentences.text: Nunca olvidaré su rostro.
sentences.translation: I'll never forget her face.

sentences.text: Tenía el rostro cansado y triste.
sentences.translation: His face looked tired and sad.

sentences.text: En la fiesta vi muchos rostros conocidos.
sentences.translation: At the party I saw many familiar faces.

sentences.text: He perdido la tarjeta de crédito.
sentences.translation: I've lost my credit card.

sentences.text: Pidieron un crédito para comprar la casa.
sentences.translation: They took out a loan to buy the house.

sentences.text: Compramos los muebles a crédito.
sentences.translation: We bought the furniture on credit.

sentences.text: Ahora los bancos dan menos créditos.
sentences.translation: Banks give out fewer loans now.

sentences.text: Comparto piso con dos amigos.
sentences.translation: I share an apartment with two friends.

sentences.text: ¿Compartimos una pizza?
sentences.translation: Shall we share a pizza?

sentences.text: Mi hermano nunca comparte sus juguetes.
sentences.translation: My brother never shares his toys.

sentences.text: Hemos compartido muchos momentos buenos.
sentences.translation: We've shared lots of good times.

notes: el registro civil = the registry office.

sentences.text: No hay ningún registro de esa llamada.
sentences.translation: There's no record of that call.

sentences.text: El hospital guarda los registros de los pacientes.
sentences.translation: The hospital keeps the patients' records.

sentences.text: Mi tía trabaja en el registro civil.
sentences.translation: My aunt works at the registry office.

sentences.text: Desde arriba, la vista es grandiosa.
sentences.translation: From the top, the view is magnificent.

sentences.text: Fue un concierto grandioso.
sentences.translation: It was a magnificent concert.

sentences.text: Tenía planes grandiosos para el futuro.
sentences.translation: He had grand plans for the future.

notes: The inside corner of a room is el rincón.

sentences.text: La farmacia está justo en la esquina.
sentences.translation: The pharmacy is right on the corner.

sentences.text: Gira a la derecha en la próxima esquina.
sentences.translation: Turn right at the next corner.

sentences.text: Cuidado con las esquinas de la mesa.
sentences.translation: Watch out for the corners of the table.

sentences.text: Anoche hubo una tormenta muy fuerte.
sentences.translation: There was a big storm last night.

sentences.text: Viene una tormenta, vamos a casa.
sentences.translation: There's a storm coming, let's go home.

sentences.text: En esta zona hay muchas tormentas por la tarde.
sentences.translation: In this area there are lots of storms in the afternoon.

notes: Usually relajarse: me relajo = I relax.

sentences.text: Relájate y disfruta del viaje.
sentences.translation: Relax and enjoy the trip.

sentences.text: Leer me relaja mucho.
sentences.translation: Reading relaxes me a lot.

sentences.text: Necesito relajarme un poco.
sentences.translation: I need to relax a bit.

sentences.text: Me encanta el chocolate negro.
sentences.translation: I love dark chocolate.

sentences.text: ¿Quieres un trozo de chocolate?
sentences.translation: Do you want a piece of chocolate?

sentences.text: En invierno tomamos chocolate caliente.
sentences.translation: In winter we drink hot chocolate.

sentences.text: Encontré un pedazo de papel con su número.
sentences.translation: I found a piece of paper with her number on it.

sentences.text: El vaso se rompió en mil pedazos.
sentences.translation: The glass broke into a thousand pieces.

sentences.text: Solo quiero un pedazo pequeño de tarta.
sentences.translation: I only want a small piece of cake.

sentences.text: Hay un olor raro en el coche.
sentences.translation: There's a strange smell in the car.

sentences.text: El olor del café me despierta.
sentences.translation: The smell of coffee wakes me up.

sentences.text: El mercado está lleno de colores y olores.
sentences.translation: The market is full of colors and smells.

sentences.text: Me interesa mucho la ciencia.
sentences.translation: I'm very interested in science.

sentences.text: En el colegio se me daban bien las ciencias.
sentences.translation: At school I was good at science.

sentences.text: Leo mucha ciencia ficción.
sentences.translation: I read a lot of science fiction.

sentences.text: Aquí la conexión a internet es muy lenta.
sentences.translation: The internet connection here is very slow.

sentences.text: Hay una conexión especial entre ellos.
sentences.translation: There's a special connection between them.

sentences.text: Hay buenas conexiones de tren con la capital.
sentences.translation: There are good train connections to the capital.

sentences.text: Estamos viendo la tele en el salón.
sentences.translation: We're watching TV in the living room.

sentences.text: Nuestro salón es pequeño pero cómodo.
sentences.translation: Our living room is small but comfortable.

sentences.text: Los salones de este hotel son enormes.
sentences.translation: The halls in this hotel are huge.

sentences.text: La ventana está muy sucia.
sentences.translation: The window is very dirty.

sentences.text: Hay platos sucios por todas partes.
sentences.translation: There are dirty dishes everywhere.

sentences.text: No toques eso, está sucio.
sentences.translation: Don't touch that, it's dirty.

sentences.text: Necesito tu firma aquí abajo.
sentences.translation: I need your signature down here.

sentences.text: Ya tenemos cien firmas.
sentences.translation: We already have a hundred signatures.

sentences.text: Trabaja en una firma de abogados.
sentences.translation: She works at a law firm.

notes: casarse con alguien = to marry someone. casado = married.

sentences.text: Quiero casarme en la playa.
sentences.translation: I want to get married on the beach.

sentences.text: Nos casamos hace diez años.
sentences.translation: We got married ten years ago.

sentences.text: Mis padres se casaron muy jóvenes.
sentences.translation: My parents got married very young.

sentences.text: Las bebidas están en la nevera.
sentences.translation: The drinks are in the fridge.

sentences.text: La comida está bien, pero la bebida es cara.
sentences.translation: The food is fine, but the drinks are expensive.

sentences.text: Pedimos algo de comer y dos bebidas.
sentences.translation: We ordered something to eat and two drinks.

notes: Used before a past form: recién llegado = just arrived.

sentences.text: Cuidado, el banco está recién pintado.
sentences.translation: Careful, the bench has just been painted.

sentences.text: El pan está recién hecho.
sentences.translation: The bread is freshly baked.

sentences.text: Tienen un bebé recién nacido.
sentences.translation: They have a newborn baby.

sentences.text: El examen no era tan complicado.
sentences.translation: The exam wasn't that hard.

sentences.text: Ha sido una semana complicada.
sentences.translation: It's been a difficult week.

sentences.text: Las instrucciones son demasiado complicadas.
sentences.translation: The instructions are too complicated.

sentences.text: Tiene problemas de visión.
sentences.translation: He has problems with his eyesight.

sentences.text: Los dos tienen visiones muy distintas de la vida.
sentences.translation: The two of them have very different views of life.

sentences.text: Tiene una visión muy clara del futuro.
sentences.translation: She has a very clear vision of the future.

sentences.text: Lo hago por diversión.
sentences.translation: I do it for fun.

sentences.text: En este pueblo hay poca diversión para los jóvenes.
sentences.translation: There isn't much fun for young people in this village.

sentences.text: Los niños solo buscan diversión.
sentences.translation: The kids are only looking for fun.

notes: Also a pound in weight, about half a kilo.

sentences.text: Esta camiseta cuesta diez libras.
sentences.translation: This T-shirt costs ten pounds.

sentences.text: Cambié euros por libras en el aeropuerto.
sentences.translation: I changed euros into pounds at the airport.

sentences.text: ¿A cuánto está la libra hoy?
sentences.translation: How much is the pound worth today?

sentences.text: Estoy haciendo un curso de cocina.
sentences.translation: I'm doing a cooking course.

sentences.text: ¿En qué curso está tu hijo?
sentences.translation: What year is your son in at school?

sentences.text: El curso empieza en septiembre.
sentences.translation: The school year starts in September.

sentences.text: He hecho varios cursos de inglés.
sentences.translation: I've done several English courses.

notes: el disco duro = the hard drive.

sentences.text: El grupo acaba de sacar un disco nuevo.
sentences.translation: The band has just released a new album.

sentences.text: Mi padre tiene muchos discos antiguos.
sentences.translation: My father has lots of old records.

sentences.text: Está todo en el disco duro.
sentences.translation: It's all on the hard drive.

notes: poco probable = unlikely.

sentences.text: ¿Va a llover? Es muy probable.
sentences.translation: Is it going to rain? It's very likely.

sentences.text: Lo más probable es que no conteste.
sentences.translation: Most likely he won't answer.

sentences.text: Es poco probable que venga.
sentences.translation: She's unlikely to come.

sentences.text: Fuimos a nadar al lago.
sentences.translation: We went swimming in the lake.

sentences.text: Hay un camino alrededor del lago.
sentences.translation: There's a path around the lake.

sentences.text: Desde el avión se ven los lagos.
sentences.translation: You can see the lakes from the plane.

notes: Also a form of parecer: me ha parecido = it seemed to me.

sentences.text: Tu coche es parecido al mío.
sentences.translation: Your car is similar to mine.

sentences.text: Las dos hermanas son muy parecidas.
sentences.translation: The two sisters are very alike.

sentences.text: A mí me pasó algo parecido.
sentences.translation: Something similar happened to me.

sentences.text: ¿De qué material es la mesa?
sentences.translation: What material is the table made of?

sentences.text: Los materiales de construcción son caros.
sentences.translation: Building materials are expensive.

sentences.text: Ya he comprado el material escolar.
sentences.translation: I've already bought the school supplies.

sentences.text: Mi tío dio un discurso en la boda.
sentences.translation: My uncle gave a speech at the wedding.

sentences.text: El discurso fue demasiado largo.
sentences.translation: The speech was too long.

sentences.text: Odio hablar en público y dar discursos.
sentences.translation: I hate speaking in public and giving speeches.

sentences.text: Llevo el pelo corto.
sentences.translation: I have short hair.

sentences.text: Las vacaciones se me hicieron cortas.
sentences.translation: The vacation felt short.

sentences.text: En invierno los días son más cortos.
sentences.translation: In winter the days are shorter.

notes: The same form in the plural: los lunes = on Mondays.

sentences.text: Este año mi cumpleaños cae en lunes.
sentences.translation: This year my birthday falls on a Monday.

sentences.text: Los lunes voy al gimnasio.
sentences.translation: On Mondays I go to the gym.

sentences.text: Este lunes no hay clase.
sentences.translation: There's no class this Monday.

notes: Also a describing word: effective.

sentences.text: ¿Va a pagar con tarjeta o en efectivo?
sentences.translation: Are you paying by card or in cash?

sentences.text: Siempre llevo algo de efectivo por si acaso.
sentences.translation: I always carry some cash, just in case.

sentences.text: En ese bar solo aceptan efectivo.
sentences.translation: That bar only takes cash.

notes: el cura (masculine) = the priest.

sentences.text: Esta enfermedad no tiene cura.
sentences.translation: There's no cure for this disease.

sentences.text: Los médicos buscan una cura para el cáncer.
sentences.translation: Doctors are looking for a cure for cancer.

sentences.text: El descanso es la mejor cura.
sentences.translation: Rest is the best cure.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo murió de cáncer.
sentences.translation: My grandfather died of cancer.

sentences.text: Fumar puede causar cáncer.
sentences.translation: Smoking can cause cancer.

sentences.text: Ganó la lucha contra el cáncer.
sentences.translation: She won her fight against cancer.

sentences.text: Hubo una comida después del funeral.
sentences.translation: There was a meal after the funeral.

sentences.text: Fue mucha gente al funeral.
sentences.translation: Lots of people went to the funeral.

sentences.text: Mi madre siempre llora en los funerales.
sentences.translation: My mother always cries at funerals.

notes: The same form for a man or a woman: el artista, la artista.

sentences.text: Mi hija quiere ser artista.
sentences.translation: My daughter wants to be an artist.

sentences.text: Este barrio está lleno de artistas.
sentences.translation: This neighborhood is full of artists.

sentences.text: El artista firmó el cuadro.
sentences.translation: The artist signed the painting.

sentences.text: Este es mi sitio favorito para comer.
sentences.translation: This is my favorite place to eat.

sentences.text: ¿Quiénes son tus actores favoritos?
sentences.translation: Who are your favorite actors?

sentences.text: Estas son mis gafas favoritas.
sentences.translation: These are my favorite glasses.

sentences.text: Estoy nervioso por la entrevista de trabajo.
sentences.translation: I'm nervous about the job interview.

sentences.text: Me hicieron la entrevista por teléfono.
sentences.translation: They did the interview by phone.

sentences.text: Esa actriz nunca da entrevistas.
sentences.translation: That actress never gives interviews.

sentences.text: Cuidado, la pintura todavía está fresca.
sentences.translation: Careful, the paint is still wet.

sentences.text: Necesitamos dos botes de pintura.
sentences.translation: We need two tins of paint.

sentences.text: Mi hermana da clases de pintura.
sentences.translation: My sister teaches painting classes.

sentences.text: Sus pinturas se venden muy caras.
sentences.translation: Her paintings sell for a lot of money.

sentences.text: ¡Estate quieto!
sentences.translation: Keep still!

sentences.text: Los niños no pueden estar quietos.
sentences.translation: The kids can't sit still.

sentences.text: El agua del lago estaba quieta.
sentences.translation: The water in the lake was still.

sentences.text: Ese billete es falso.
sentences.translation: That banknote is fake.

sentences.text: Me dio un nombre y una dirección falsos.
sentences.translation: He gave me a fake name and address.

sentences.text: No me gusta la gente falsa.
sentences.translation: I don't like fake people.

sentences.text: Tiene una inteligencia increíble.
sentences.translation: She has incredible intelligence.

sentences.text: Para eso no hace falta mucha inteligencia.
sentences.translation: That doesn't take much intelligence.

sentences.text: Trabaja para los servicios de inteligencia.
sentences.translation: He works for the intelligence services.

notes: Some forms have a y: destruye, destruyó.

sentences.text: El azúcar destruye los dientes.
sentences.translation: Sugar destroys your teeth.

sentences.text: El fuego destruyó la casa.
sentences.translation: The fire destroyed the house.

sentences.text: La ciudad quedó destruida en la guerra.
sentences.translation: The city was destroyed in the war.

notes: Also a describing word, freezing: el agua está helada.

sentences.text: Los niños comen helado casi todos los días.
sentences.translation: The kids eat ice cream almost every day.

sentences.text: Mi helado preferido es el de limón.
sentences.translation: My favorite ice cream is lemon.

sentences.text: Compramos dos helados en la playa.
sentences.translation: We bought two ice creams at the beach.

notes: el casco antiguo = the old part of a town.

sentences.text: Ponte el casco antes de subir a la moto.
sentences.translation: Put your helmet on before you get on the motorbike.

sentences.text: En la obra todos llevan casco.
sentences.translation: On the building site everyone wears a helmet.

sentences.text: Los niños llevan cascos para ir en bici.
sentences.translation: The kids wear helmets to ride their bikes.

notes: In Spain a closed van is usually una furgoneta.

sentences.text: Llevamos los muebles en la camioneta.
sentences.translation: We took the furniture in the van.

sentences.text: Mi vecino tiene una camioneta blanca.
sentences.translation: My neighbor has a white van.

sentences.text: Esas camionetas son de la empresa.
sentences.translation: Those vans belong to the company.

notes: o becomes ue in some forms: muevo, mueve. To move house is mudarse.

sentences.text: ¿Me ayudas a mover el sofá?
sentences.translation: Can you help me move the sofa?

sentences.text: No te muevas, tienes una abeja en el pelo.
sentences.translation: Don't move, there's a bee in your hair.

sentences.text: Mueve un poco la mesa a la izquierda.
sentences.translation: Move the table a little to the left.

sentences.text: Alguien ha movido mis papeles.
sentences.translation: Someone has moved my papers.

sentences.text: Pon esto aparte, es para tu madre.
sentences.translation: Put this aside, it's for your mother.

sentences.text: Las bebidas se pagan aparte.
sentences.translation: Drinks are paid for separately.

sentences.text: Aparte de eso, todo va bien.
sentences.translation: Apart from that, everything is fine.

sentences.text: Cada año llevamos flores a su tumba.
sentences.translation: Every year we take flowers to her grave.

sentences.text: Se llevó el secreto a la tumba.
sentences.translation: He took the secret to his grave.

sentences.text: Las tumbas de los reyes están en la iglesia.
sentences.translation: The kings' tombs are in the church.

notes: It ends in -a but it is masculine: el mapa.

sentences.text: ¿Tienes un mapa de la ciudad?
sentences.translation: Do you have a map of the city?

sentences.text: Nos perdimos porque el mapa estaba mal.
sentences.translation: We got lost because the map was wrong.

sentences.text: Mi hijo tiene una colección de mapas.
sentences.translation: My son has a collection of maps.

notes: In Latin America, la tarea is also homework; in Spain that is los deberes.

sentences.text: Cada uno tiene su tarea.
sentences.translation: Everyone has their own job.

sentences.text: Las tareas de la casa las hacemos entre todos.
sentences.translation: We all do the housework together.

sentences.text: No es una tarea fácil.
sentences.translation: It's not an easy task.

notes: In Latin America: el celular.

sentences.text: Mi hijo quiere un móvil para su cumpleaños.
sentences.translation: My son wants a phone for his birthday.

sentences.text: Se me ha caído el móvil al agua.
sentences.translation: I've dropped my phone in the water.

sentences.text: En la mesa, nada de móviles.
sentences.translation: No phones at the table.

sentences.text: Respondo a vuestras preguntas después de la clase.
sentences.translation: I'll answer your questions after class.

sentences.text: Respondió que no sabía nada.
sentences.translation: She replied that she didn't know anything.

sentences.text: Todavía no me ha respondido.
sentences.translation: He still hasn't replied to me.

sentences.text: La nevera está vacía.
sentences.translation: The fridge is empty.

sentences.text: El restaurante estaba casi vacío.
sentences.translation: The restaurant was almost empty.

sentences.text: Tira las botellas vacías, por favor.
sentences.translation: Throw away the empty bottles, please.

notes: In Latin America: la computadora.

sentences.text: Mi ordenador va muy lento.
sentences.translation: My computer is very slow.

sentences.text: Trabajo todo el día con el ordenador.
sentences.translation: I work on the computer all day.

sentences.text: En la biblioteca hay ordenadores para todos.
sentences.translation: The library has computers for everyone.

notes: The same form for a man or a woman: el estudiante, la estudiante.

sentences.text: Mi hermano es estudiante de Derecho.
sentences.translation: My brother is a law student.

sentences.text: Hay descuento para estudiantes.
sentences.translation: There's a discount for students.

sentences.text: Los estudiantes tienen exámenes en junio.
sentences.translation: The students have exams in June.

notes: Some forms have a y: construye, construyó.

sentences.text: Quieren construir un parque aquí.
sentences.translation: They want to build a park here.

sentences.text: Están construyendo un hospital nuevo.
sentences.translation: They're building a new hospital.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo construyó esta casa.
sentences.translation: My grandfather built this house.

sentences.text: Tiene que haber una solución.
sentences.translation: There has to be a solution.

sentences.text: Por fin encontramos la solución al problema.
sentences.translation: We finally found the solution to the problem.

sentences.text: Buscamos soluciones, no problemas.
sentences.translation: We're looking for solutions, not problems.

notes: el Mundial = the World Cup.

sentences.text: La economía mundial va mal.
sentences.translation: The world economy is doing badly.

sentences.text: Tiene el récord mundial.
sentences.translation: He holds the world record.

sentences.text: Las dos guerras mundiales cambiaron Europa.
sentences.translation: The two world wars changed Europe.

sentences.text: Hoy me toca lavar los platos.
sentences.translation: Today it's my turn to do the dishes.

sentences.text: Este es el plato típico de la región.
sentences.translation: This is the typical dish of the region.

sentences.text: De primer plato, quiero sopa.
sentences.translation: For the first course, I'd like soup.

sentences.text: Se hizo famoso con su primer disco.
sentences.translation: He became famous with his first album.

sentences.text: Su madre es una cantante muy famosa.
sentences.translation: His mother is a very famous singer.

sentences.text: Estos cuadros son famosos en todo el mundo.
sentences.translation: These paintings are famous all over the world.

sentences.text: Mi abuela no se lleva bien con la tecnología.
sentences.translation: My grandmother doesn't get on with technology.

sentences.text: La tecnología está en todas partes.
sentences.translation: Technology is everywhere.

sentences.text: Los jóvenes usan las nuevas tecnologías sin problema.
sentences.translation: Young people use new technology easily.

sentences.text: Te ayudo con una condición.
sentences.translation: I'll help you on one condition.

sentences.text: Las condiciones de trabajo son muy malas.
sentences.translation: The working conditions are very bad.

sentences.text: Viven en condiciones muy duras.
sentences.translation: They live in very hard conditions.

notes: dudar de alguien = to doubt someone. la duda = the doubt.

sentences.text: —¿Vendrá? —Lo dudo.
sentences.translation: "Will he come?" "I doubt it."

sentences.text: Nunca he dudado de ti.
sentences.translation: I've never doubted you.

sentences.text: No dudó ni un segundo.
sentences.translation: She didn't hesitate for a second.

sentences.text: Si necesitas algo, no dudes en llamarme.
sentences.translation: If you need anything, don't hesitate to call me.

notes: In speech, rápido is more common: ven rápido = come quickly.

sentences.text: Las noticias corren rápidamente.
sentences.translation: News travels fast.

sentences.text: Cerró la puerta rápidamente.
sentences.translation: He quickly closed the door.

sentences.text: Todo pasó muy rápidamente.
sentences.translation: It all happened very quickly.

notes: Almost always in a bordo = on board (a ship, a plane).

sentences.text: Bienvenidos a bordo.
sentences.translation: Welcome aboard.

sentences.text: Había cien pasajeros a bordo.
sentences.translation: There were a hundred passengers on board.

sentences.text: No se puede fumar a bordo.
sentences.translation: Smoking isn't allowed on board.

notes: A romantic date is una cita.

sentences.text: Escribe la fecha en la parte de arriba.
sentences.translation: Write the date at the top.

sentences.text: Ya tenemos fecha para el viaje.
sentences.translation: We already have a date for the trip.

sentences.text: No recuerdo las fechas de los exámenes.
sentences.translation: I don't remember the exam dates.

sentences.text: Los niños ven demasiada violencia en la tele.
sentences.translation: Kids see too much violence on TV.

sentences.text: Está en contra de la violencia.
sentences.translation: He's against violence.

sentences.text: Hubo violencia después del partido.
sentences.translation: There was violence after the match.

notes: When it means a person, it sounds a bit cold, like police talk.

sentences.text: Un sujeto raro preguntó por ti.
sentences.translation: A strange guy asked about you.

sentences.text: Ese sujeto lleva una hora en la puerta.
sentences.translation: That guy has been at the door for an hour.

sentences.text: Buscan sujetos para un estudio médico.
sentences.translation: They're looking for subjects for a medical study.
